title: Amplitude containments implied by amplification
statement:
Let $\square=(f,f',g,g',\alpha)$ be a cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $f:X\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $g:Y'\to Y$ and $g':X'\to X$. Fix an adic coefficient datum $(A,I)$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum] and a nonnegative integer $c$. Use the scheme and coefficient conventions of [def-weil-pbc-constructible-direct-image-finiteness] required in [def-weil-pbc-finite-level-amplification]: $Y,Y'$ are Noetherian of finite dimension, and for every positive $n$ the additive order of every element of $P_n=A/I^n$ is invertible in every local ring of $Y$ and $Y'$. Suppose $\mathrm{AMP}(\square;c)$ holds. Then for every $n\geq1$, with $P_n=A/I^n$, and all $a\leq b$,
$$
 \begin{aligned}
  Rf_*\bigl(D^b_c(X_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b]}\bigr)
  &\subset D^b_c(Y_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b+c]},\\
  Rf'_*\bigl(D^b_c(X'_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b]}\bigr)
  &\subset D^b_c(Y'_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b+c]},\\
  Lg_n^*\bigl(D^b_c(Y_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b]}\bigr)
  &\subset D^b_c(Y'_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b]},\\
  Lg_n'^*\bigl(D^b_c(X_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b]}\bigr)
  &\subset D^b_c(X'_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b]}.
 \end{aligned}
$$

note:
*Source note:* no Stacks Project entry states these four containments: they
are formal consequences of the predicate of
[def-weil-pbc-finite-level-amplification], whose etale inputs are Lemma
59.92.2 ([Tag 095U](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/095U), the
amplitude bound $R^qf_*=0$ for $q>2n$ when the fibres have dimension
$\le n$) and Theorem 63.14.5 ([Tag
0GL0](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0GL0), constructibility of
$Rf_!$), together with Definition 61.29.1 ([Tag
09C1](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09C1)) and Proposition 61.29.7
([Tag 09C7](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09C7)) for adic
constructibility; the blueprint adds the assembly of the containments for
the four functors of one square.

proof.text: At the positive level n, identify the given discrete coefficient topology with the canonical bottom topology using DiscreteTopology.eq_bot. Unfold HasFiniteLevelAmplification [def-weil-pbc-finite-level-amplification] and extract FIN(f,P_n;c), FIN(f′,P_n;c) [def-weil-pbc-constructible-direct-image-finiteness], and both pullback amplification clauses. Apply restrictionDirectImage [prop-weil-pbc-restriction-direct-image] separately to the two FIN clauses. For each bounded constructible ambient object K, bundle K with its constructibility proof as an object of the full subcategory; the restriction theorem then gives constructibility and the interval [a,b+c] for its direct image. For each pullback, pair the constructibility clause of finiteCoefficientPullbackAmplifies with its interval clause, applied to a, b, a≤b and K. Assemble the four containments.

statement_change.what: The original text leaves the type and nonnegativity of c and the scheme/coefficient conventions for AMP implicit. The AMP definition expressly requires the FIN conventions; its Lean interface cannot be applied without their proofs. Explicitly bind the four arrows, the adic datum, nonnegative c, and precisely these existing conventions (Noetherian finite-dimensional Y and Y prime, and invertibility of additive orders at every level). No new mathematical condition beyond the cited AMP convention or change of any containment is introduced.

citers.note: All four schemes are explicitly Noetherian of finite dimension. The given invertible positive N annihilating A/I has N^n annihilating P_n; every finite additive order divides N^n and is therefore a unit. The common bound c=2e is nonnegative. The use of all four containments is unchanged.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $\square$ be a cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] with
$\Lambda$-coefficient data as in the adic coefficient datum and suppose that
$\mathrm{AMP}(\square;c)$ of [def-weil-pbc-finite-level-amplification]
holds. Then for every $n\geq1$, with $P_n=A/I^n$, and all $a\leq b$,
$$
 \begin{aligned}
  Rf_*\bigl(D^b_c(X_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b]}\bigr)
  &\subset D^b_c(Y_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b+c]},\\
  Rf'_*\bigl(D^b_c(X'_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b]}\bigr)
  &\subset D^b_c(Y'_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b+c]},\\
  Lg_n^*\bigl(D^b_c(Y_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b]}\bigr)
  &\subset D^b_c(Y'_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b]},\\
  Lg_n'^*\bigl(D^b_c(X_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b]}\bigr)
  &\subset D^b_c(X'_{\Proet},P_n)^{[a,b]}.
 \end{aligned}
$$

proof.text:
By [def-weil-pbc-finite-level-amplification] the condition
$\mathrm{AMP}(\square;c)$ consists, for every $n\geq1$, of the finiteness
conditions $\mathrm{FIN}(f,P_n;c)$ and $\mathrm{FIN}(f',P_n;c)$ of
[def-weil-pbc-constructible-direct-image-finiteness] and of the restriction
of the pullbacks $Lg_n^*,Lg_n'^*$ to exact triangulated functors carrying
the class of objects with cohomology in $[a,b]$ into the same class. The
finiteness conditions supply the hypotheses of
[prop-weil-pbc-restriction-direct-image], which therefore yields the first
two displayed containments; the restriction clause is the conclusion of
[lem-weil-pbc-pullback-preserves-bounded-constructible] for the two
coordinates, which yields the last two.
